## Course overview

-   **Acquisition of Practical Bioinformatics Analysis Skills**

    ✅ What is RNA-seq data and how to analyze them

    ✅ Understanding fundamental statistics

    ✅ How to interpret and visualize the results

-   **Enhanced Data Convergence Capability for Translational Research**

    ✅ How to link omics data to clinical data

    ✅ How to explore public data of interest

    ✅ What would be promising targets

## Syllabus

| Module | Week | Contents | Key tools |
|----|----|----|----|
| **Intro** | W1 | Review + Roadmap + R env | R, Bioconductor |
| **Clinical Genomics** | W2 | GWAS & Post-GWAS | PLINK, LocusZoom |
|  | W3 | PRS & Clinical application | PGPRSice, LDPred2 |
| **Single-cell** | W4 | scRNA-seq tech, QC, Clustering | Seurat, scanpy |
|  | W5 | Trajectory & Cell-cell communication | Monocle, CellChat |
| **Spatial** | W6 | Spatial Transcriptomics 기초 | Seurat, Squidpy |
|  | W7 | Spatial + scRNA integration, Deconvolution | CARD, SPOTlight |
| **Proteomics** | W8 | MS/NGS-based Proteomics | theory |
|  | W9 | Clinical proteomics & Biomarker | limma, MSstats |
| **Integration** | W10 | Multi-omics integration | MOFA+, mixOmics |
|  | W11 | Network & Drug target discovery | STRING, igraph |
| **Capstone** | W12 | Result intepretation & visualization | ggplot2, Rmarkdown |
|  | W13 | Rscript & vibe coding tips | — |
|  | W14 | Individual project design | — |
